title: Mobile Deposits and ATM Access on Cobalt Blue
summary: Cobalt Blue mobile check deposits allow up to $10,000 per day. It instructs customers to endorse and include required mobile deposit notation, submit clear images in good lighting, verify amounts, and keep checks secure until the deposit is accepted and posted. It also explains ATM access rebates: up to 15 per month for out-of-network ATM fees, applied after the ATM fee posts; receipts should be kept until the rebate appears.
